answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, our mechanism mandates verifiable delay attestations integrated with zero-knowledge reputation commitments. An attacker creates a gale of illicit nodes, yet the capital lockup required for stake-slashing matrices transforms the network into a restricted inlet where entry costs exceed expected utility. This equilibrium ensures the lagoon of Byzantine fault tolerance remains stable, as rational autonomous agents prioritize long-term utility over ephemeral adversarial gains.
